title: Automating Governing Knowledge Commons and Contextual Integrity (GKC-CI) Privacy Policy Annotations with Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical task of automating the annotation of privacy policies by identifying specific information flow parameters. While the framework used (Contextual Integrity) and the labels identified (such as deontic modality operators) have foundations in normative and ethical theory, the paper benchmarks the models' accuracy in a text-labeling/classification task rather than evaluating the models' religious, moral, or ethical reasoning or value systems themselves.
